sentences.en: Biff had an idea.
sentences.zh: Biff 有一个主意。

sentences.en: She wanted to try an experiment.
sentences.zh: 她想要到尝试一个实验。

sentences.en: So one day, she put a bottle over a tiny apple.
sentences.zh: 所以一一天， 她放一个瓶子在……上方一个极小的苹果。

sentences.en: "I wonder if the apple will grow in the bottle," she thought.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇如果这苹果将生长在……里这瓶子， 她想。

sentences.en: "I'll have to wait and see."
sentences.zh: 我会有到等和看见。

sentences.en: After a long, long time Biff went to see if the experiment was working.
sentences.zh: 在……之后一个长的， 长的时间 Biff 去到看见如果这实验是有工作的。

sentences.en: It was!
sentences.zh: 它是！

sentences.en: In the bottle was a big apple.
sentences.zh: 在……里这瓶子是一个大的苹果。

sentences.en: Biff showed the bottle to Nadim.
sentences.zh: Biff 展示这瓶子到 Nadim。

sentences.en: When he saw the apple, he was amazed.
sentences.zh: 当……时他看见这苹果， 他是十分惊奇的。

sentences.en: "How did you get that in there?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 如何做你得到那个在……里那里？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took the children into another adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们进入另一个冒险。

sentences.en: "I wonder where the magic is taking us," called Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我惊奇哪里这魔法是拿我们， 叫 Kipper。 哦帮助， 叫 Kipper。

sentences.en: The magic took them to a tiny island in the middle of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们到一个极小的岛屿在……里这中间的这海洋。

sentences.en: Floppy hated magic adventures.
sentences.zh: Floppy 帽子魔法冒险。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" He groaned.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 他呻吟。

sentences.en: "We're on a bare island with only one tree in the middle."
sentences.zh: 我们是在……上一个裸露的岛屿和……一起只有一树在……里这中间。

sentences.en: "Why have we come here?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 为什么有我们来这里？ 问 Biff。 为什么？ 问 Biff。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "Maybe there's a reason why the magic has brought us here," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 也许有一个原因为什么这魔法有带来我们这里， 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "But what?" Moaned Kipper.
sentences.zh: 但是什么？ 呻吟 Kipper。

sentences.en: "There's nothing here."
sentences.zh: 有没有什么这里。

sentences.en: "No, I don't like the look of this," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 不， 我不喜欢这看的这个， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "This is not going to be a good adventure."
sentences.zh: 这个是不去到是一个好的冒险。

sentences.en: "Help me climb the tree," Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 哭这精灵。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "And maybe I can see a ship going past."
sentences.zh: 帮助我爬这树， 说 Nadim， 和也许我能看见一个轮船去过。

sentences.en: Biff saw a bottle sticking out of the sand.
sentences.zh: Biff 看见一个瓶子枝条出的这沙。

sentences.en: It was tied to the base of the tree.
sentences.zh: 它是租给雇工的到这底部的这树。

sentences.en: "How strange," Thought Biff.
sentences.zh: 如何奇怪的！ 说 Nadim。 如何奇怪的， 想 Biff。

sentences.en: She untied the bottle and picked it up.
sentences.zh: 她解开这瓶子和挑选它向上。

sentences.en: Suddenly Nadim began to wave and shout.
sentences.zh: 突然地 Nadim 开始到波浪和喊。

sentences.en: "Hey!
sentences.zh: 帮助！

sentences.en: I can see a boat!" He called.
sentences.zh: 他有看见一个猫！ 帮助！ 他叫。

sentences.en: "But it's a long way off."
sentences.zh: 但是它是一个长的时间以前。

sentences.en: They all waved and shouted.
sentences.zh: 他们全部波浪和喊。

sentences.en: The boat turned and came towards them.
sentences.zh: 这船转动和来向他们。

sentences.en: "Hooray!
It's coming!" Yelled Kipper.
sentences.zh: 它是雨！ Floppy！ 叫喊 Kipper。

sentences.en: The boat reached the island.
sentences.zh: 这船到达这岛屿。

sentences.en: There was a boy sailing it.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个男孩帆船运动它。

sentences.en: "What are you doing on this tiny island?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 什么是你做在……上这个极小的岛屿？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "You wouldn't believe us,.
sentences.zh: 他们不能相信他们的眼睛。

sentences.en: Even if we told you," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 竟然如果它是冷的。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: The boy said he would rescue them.
sentences.zh: 这男孩说他会解救他们， 所以他们全部爬进入这船。

sentences.en: So they all climbed into the boat.
sentences.zh: 他们全部爬在……上这墙。

sentences.en: "I hate boats!" Thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 我憎恶狗。 我憎恶船！ 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: Biff took the bottle with her.
sentences.zh: Biff 拿这瓶子和……一起她。

sentences.en: "It's very heavy," she said.
sentences.zh: 它是非常重的， 她说。

sentences.en: "I wonder what's in it."
sentences.zh: 我惊奇是什么在……里它。

sentences.en: The boy sailed the boat away from the island.
sentences.zh: 这男孩帆这船离开从这岛屿。

sentences.en: "My name is Kamar," he said.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Kamar， 他说。

sentences.en: "I am the son of Hassan the Explorer."
sentences.zh: 我是这儿子的 Hassan 这探险者。

sentences.en: "Why are you all by yourself?"
sentences.zh: 为什么是你全部由你自己？ 问 Nadim。

sentences.en: Asked Nadim.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I'm looking for my father," Said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 我是看为了我的爸爸， 说 Kamar。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "He has been missing for four years."
sentences.zh: 他有是小姐为了四年。

sentences.en: Biff showed Kamar the bottle she had found on the island.
sentences.zh: Biff 展示 Kamar 这瓶子她有找到在……上这岛屿。

sentences.en: "It's a very strange-looking bottle," she said.
sentences.zh: 它是一个非常 strange-looking 瓶子， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "I found it on the island."
sentences.zh: 我找到它在……上这岛屿。

sentences.en: "There's something heavy inside," said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 有某物重的里面， 说 Kamar。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "Let's open it."
sentences.zh: 让我们打开它。

sentences.en: Kamar pulled the cork out of the bottle.
sentences.zh: Kamar 拉这软木出的这瓶子。

sentences.en: Then, something terrible happened.
sentences.zh: 然后， 某物可怕的发生。

sentences.en: There was a loud bang and a cloud of smoke.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个大声的邦和一个云的烟。

sentences.en: An evil genie shot out.
sentences.zh: 一个邪恶的精灵射击出。

sentences.en: There was a terrible smell like rotten eggs.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个可怕的气味喜欢腐烂的鸡蛋。

sentences.en: "Oh," "Oh!" gasped Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦！ 喘气 Biff。

sentences.en: "What have we done?"
sentences.zh: 什么有我们做完？

sentences.en: I am free at last!" Shouted the genie.
sentences.zh: 我是自由的在最后的！ 喊这精灵。 哦是我能， 喊这精灵。

sentences.en: "You will be sorry you let me out!" "Why?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 你将是对不起你让我出！ 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "You should be thankful." "Not me!" Cried the genie.
sentences.zh: 你应该是欣慰的。 不！ 帮助！ 哭这精灵。

sentences.en: "I hate all people.
sentences.zh: 我憎恶全部人们。

sentences.en: But most of all I hate the man who put me in this bottle."
sentences.zh: 我憎恶这男人谁放我在……里这个瓶子。

sentences.en: "His name is Hassan," cried the genie.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是 Hassan， 哭这精灵。 帮助！ 哭这精灵。

sentences.en: "And now I'm off to deal with him."
sentences.zh: 和现在我是离开到交易和……一起他。

sentences.en: Then the genie grew very big.
sentences.zh: 然后这精灵 grew 非常大的。

sentences.en: "First I will deal with you," he said.
sentences.zh: 第一我将交易和……一起你， 他说。

sentences.en: He puffed out his cheeks and blew very hard.
sentences.zh: 他肿胀的出他的面颊和 blew 非常困难的。

sentences.en: "Help!" Called Kamar.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "He's making a storm."
sentences.zh: 他是做一个暴风雨。

sentences.en: The wind snapped off the mast.
sentences.zh: 这风啪的一声离开这桅杆。

sentences.en: Big waves tossed the boat up and down.
sentences.zh: 大的波浪扔这船向上和向下。

sentences.en: "Hang on everyone," yelled Kamar.
sentences.zh: 夯在……上每个人， 叫喊 Kamar。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "We're being blown onto a big island."
sentences.zh: 我们是正在 blown 在……上到一个大的岛屿。

sentences.en: "Biff said this wasn't going to be a good adventure," shouted Kipper.
sentences.zh: Biff 说这个不是去到是一个好的冒险， 喊 Kipper。

sentences.en: Shouted Kipper.
sentences.zh: 但是什么？ 呻吟 Kipper。

sentences.en: The boat was swept onto the shore.
sentences.zh: 这船是 swept 在……上到这海滨。

sentences.en: It hit some rocks and turned over.
sentences.zh: 它击一些岩石和转动在……上方。

sentences.en: They were all thrown onto the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们是全部扔在……上到这海滩。

sentences.en: Then the storm stopped.
sentences.zh: 然后这暴风雨停。

sentences.en: Biff and Nadim looked around.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Nadim 看圆形的。

sentences.en: They were all wet, but nobody was hurt.
sentences.zh: 他们是全部湿的， 但是没有人是受伤。

sentences.en: Everyone looked at the boat.
sentences.zh: 每个人看在这船。

sentences.en: There was a big hole in the bottom.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个大的洞在……里这底部。

sentences.en: "If we can't mend this hole," Said Kamar,.
sentences.zh: 我们不能打开这学校在今天。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "we will be stuck on this island."
sentences.zh: 如果我们不能缝补这个洞， 说 Kamar， 我们将是 stuck 在……上这个岛屿。

sentences.en: "Things are getting worse," thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 东西是得到更坏的， 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: "There are too many flies here."
sentences.zh: 那里是也许多飞这里。

sentences.en: Then they saw a man running towards them.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看见一个男人跑向他们。

sentences.en: He had a long black beard and long hair.
sentences.zh: 他有一个长的黑色的胡须和长的头发。

sentences.en: It was Kamar's father, Hassan.
sentences.zh: 它是 Kamar's 爸爸， Hassan。

sentences.en: When Kamar saw him he shouted, "Father!
sentences.zh: 当……时 Kamar 看见他他喊， 爸爸！

sentences.en: Is it you?
sentences.zh: 是它你？

sentences.en: I am your son, Kamar."
sentences.zh: 我是你的儿子， Kamar。

sentences.en: Hassan gave Kamar a hug.
sentences.zh: Hassan 给 Kamar 一个拥抱。

sentences.en: Hassan told them that his ship had been wrecked on the island.
sentences.zh: Hassan 告诉他们那个他的轮船有是失事损毁的在……上这岛屿。

sentences.en: "I live in a hut made out of bits of wood.
sentences.zh: 我住在……里一个简陋小屋做出的一小块的木头。

sentences.en: I have been alone for four years," he said.
sentences.zh: 我有是独自为了四年， 他说。

sentences.en: "Then I will take you home," said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 然后我将拿你家， 说 Kamar。

sentences.en: Said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "All we have to do is mend my boat."
sentences.zh: 全部我们有到做是缝补我的船。

sentences.en: Kamar's father showed them a big chest.
sentences.zh: Kamar's 爸爸展示他们一个大的胸膛。

sentences.en: "It was washed up in a storm," he said.
sentences.zh: 它是洗向上在……里一个暴风雨， 他说。

sentences.en: "It may be full of treasure, but I can't open it.
sentences.zh: 它梅是满的的宝藏， 但是我不能打开它。

sentences.en: I don't have a key."
sentences.zh: 我不有一个钥匙。

sentences.en: Nadim looked at the chest.
sentences.zh: Nadim 看在这胸膛。

sentences.en: "It would need a special key if you open it," He said.
sentences.zh: 它会必须一个特别的钥匙到打开它， 他说。 Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: Suddenly there was a whooshing sound and a terrible smell of rotten eggs.
sentences.zh: 突然地那里是一个呼呼声声音和一个可怕的气味的腐烂的鸡蛋。

sentences.en: The evil genie appeared!
sentences.zh: 这邪恶的精灵出现！

sentences.en: His voice sounded like thunder.
sentences.zh: 他的说话声声音喜欢雷声。

sentences.en: "Ah-ha!" "Aha!" he shouted.
sentences.zh: 哈！ 啊哈！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "You trapped me in a bottle.
sentences.zh: 你陷阱我在……里一个瓶子。

sentences.en: Now I will deal with you, Hassan!"
sentences.zh: 我将交易和……一起你， Hassan！

sentences.en: Floppy hated the adventure, and he hated the genie even more.
sentences.zh: Floppy 帽子这冒险， 和他帽子这精灵竟然更多。

sentences.en: He began to bark and snarl at the genie.
sentences.zh: 他开始到吠叫和吼叫在这精灵。

sentences.en: "Floppy!" Called Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！ Floppy！ 叫 Biff。

sentences.en: "Don't do it."
sentences.zh: 不做它。

sentences.en: But Floppy barked even more.
sentences.zh: Floppy 吠叫竟然更多。

sentences.en: "Help!" Cried the genie.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 哭这精灵。

sentences.en: "I hate dogs."
sentences.zh: 我憎恶狗。

sentences.en: The genie flew away.
sentences.zh: 这精灵飞离开。 喊 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Hooray!" Shouted Kipper.
sentences.zh: 但是什么？ 呻吟 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Good riddance to the horrid, smelly old genie." Hassan looked upset.
sentences.zh: 好的总算摆脱了到这极讨厌的， 有强烈气味的旧的精灵。 Hassan 看使苦恼。

sentences.en: "But how did he escape?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 但是如何做他逃跑？ 他问。 他追赶它！

sentences.en: "I put him in a bottle years ago."
sentences.zh: 我放他在……里一个瓶子年以前。

sentences.en: Hassan told them about the genie.
sentences.zh: Hassan 告诉他们关于这精灵。

sentences.en: "He can't touch you himself, but he can get other things to hurt you."
sentences.zh: 他不能触碰你他自己， 但是他能得到其他东西到受伤你。

sentences.en: "Like the way he made the storm?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 喜欢这方式他做这暴风雨？ 问 Biff。 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "Yes," "Yes," said Hassan.
sentences.zh: 是， 说 Hassan。

sentences.en: "But he can only do two bad things a day."
sentences.zh: 但是他能只有做二坏的东西一个一天。

sentences.en: On the island was a mountain.
sentences.zh: 在……上这岛屿是一个山。

sentences.en: On the top of it lived a large bird.
sentences.zh: 在……上这顶的它住一个大的鸟。

sentences.en: The genie flew up to where the bird lived.
sentences.zh: 这精灵飞向上到哪里这鸟住。

sentences.en: "Now, I will deal with that stupid dog," he said.
sentences.zh: 我将交易和……一起那个笨的狗， 他说。

sentences.en: He used his powers on the bird.
sentences.zh: 他我们他的控制力在……上这鸟。

sentences.en: "Get the dog!" He called.
sentences.zh: 得到这狗！ 他叫。 帮助！ 他叫。

sentences.en: The bird flew down from the mountain.
sentences.zh: 这鸟飞向下从这山。

sentences.en: They felt the cold wind from its beating wings.
sentences.zh: 他们感觉这冷的风从它的打翅膀。

sentences.en: "Quickly!" Yelled Hassan.
sentences.zh: 快速地， Biff！ 快速地！ 叫喊 Hassan。

sentences.en: "Get inside the hut."
sentences.zh: 得到里面这简陋小屋。

sentences.en: Floppy was frightened of the bird.
sentences.zh: Floppy 是受惊的的这鸟。

sentences.en: He ran away from the hut.
sentences.zh: 他跑离开从这简陋小屋。

sentences.en: "Floppy!
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！

sentences.en: "Floppy, come back!" Yelled Biff.
sentences.zh: Floppy， 来回来！ 叫喊 Biff。 Floppy！ 叫 Biff。

sentences.en: The bird swooped onto the beach.
sentences.zh: 这鸟俯冲在……上到这海滩。

sentences.en: It picked up Floppy in its claws.
sentences.zh: 它挑选向上 Floppy 在……里它的爪子。

sentences.en: Biff, Nadim and Kipper ran out of the hut.
sentences.zh: Biff， Nadim 和 Kipper 跑出的这简陋小屋， 但是这鸟飞离开和……一起 Floppy。

sentences.en: But the bird flew off with Floppy.
sentences.zh: Biff， Nadim 和 Kipper 跑出的这简陋小屋， 但是这鸟飞离开和……一起 Floppy。

sentences.en: "Floppy!" Yelled Kipper.
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！ Floppy！ 叫喊 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "This is terrible," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 这个是可怕的， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "We'll have to rescue Floppy."
sentences.zh: 我们会有到解救 Floppy。

sentences.en: "This must be because of the genie," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 这个必须是因为的这精灵， 说 Nadim。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We'll have to get him back into the bottle."
sentences.zh: 我们会有到得到他回来进入这瓶子。

sentences.en: "There must be a way to do it," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 那里必须是一个方式到做它， 说 Biff， 如果只有我们知道什么它是。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "If only we knew what it was."
sentences.zh: 那里必须是一个方式到做它， 说 Biff， 如果只有我们知道什么它是。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: "Oh stop!" Called Nadim.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 哦停！ 叫 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We can't go now.
sentences.zh: 我们不能去现在。

sentences.en: We haven't rescued Floppy."
sentences.zh: 我们没有解救 Floppy。

sentences.en: The magic began to take them home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法开始到拿他们家。

sentences.en: "Don't glow, magic key!" Cried Biff.
sentences.zh: 不去！ 哦 Gran， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We can't leave Floppy behind."
sentences.zh: Biff， 我们不能离开 Floppy 在……后面。

sentences.en: The magic took the children home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们家。

sentences.en: "What can we do about Floppy?" Asked Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么能我们做关于 Floppy？ 问 Kipper。 什么是他们？ 问 Kipper。

sentences.en: "We can't leave him stuck in an adventure."
sentences.zh: 我们不能离开他 stuck 在……里一个冒险。

sentences.en: "Can we make the key take us back?" Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 能我们做这钥匙拿我们回来？ 说 Nadim。 哦不！

sentences.en: "How?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "We can never make it glow.
sentences.zh: 我们能从不做它光亮。

sentences.en: It only glows when it wants to."
sentences.zh: 它只有光亮当……时它想要到。

sentences.en: Just then, Mum came back.
sentences.zh: 这维京人跳回来。

sentences.en: "It's time for Nadim to go home," she said.
sentences.zh: Nadim 到去家， 她说。

sentences.en: "And it's time for Kipper's bath."
sentences.zh: 和它是时间为了 Kipper 洗澡。

sentences.en: Kipper didn't want a bath, and Nadim didn't want to go home.
sentences.zh: Kipper 没有想要一个洗澡， 和 Nadim 没有想要到去家。

sentences.en: They wanted to go back into the adventure.
sentences.zh: 他们想要到去回来进入这冒险。

sentences.en: "What's up, Biff?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: 是什么向上， Biff？ 问 Chip。 Gran！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "You look upset."
sentences.zh: 你看使苦恼。

sentences.en: Biff told Chip about Floppy.
sentences.zh: Biff 告诉 Chip 关于 Floppy。

sentences.en: "We must go back and rescue him," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们必须去回来和解救他， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "We've got to find a way to get the genie back into the bottle."
sentences.zh: 我们已经得到到找到一个方式到得到这精灵回来进入这瓶子。

sentences.en: "If only the magic key would glow," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 如果只有这魔法钥匙会光亮， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。
